svz674q4.sourceDescription: Looking for a fibre optic tree that looks just as good in the day as it does lit up in the evening? We've just the tree for you. jpfw7113.variantName: Walplus 910 Branch Tips Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 210 cm
jpfw7113.sourceDescription: This stunningly dense Christmas tree with 910 branch tips creates a unique festival atmosphere! This Christmas tree will form the striking centrepiece of your Christmas decorations. Made of quality PVC material, it looks like a real tree. The tree can be used again every year, making it a very economical choice compared to a real tree. It can only be used indoors. The artificial tree is easy to assemble, thanks to its simple plug-in system. Create a unique Christmas atmosphere in your home! Delivery also includes a stable steel stand. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC, steel Total height: 210 cm Stand diameter: 45 cm Tree diameter: 110 cm 910 branches For indoor use only Easy to store Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand Fabric: PVC: 100% • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
